title: Venezuelan Lemony Flatbread
description: A simple and flavorful flatbread infused with the brightness of lemons, inspired by Venezuelan cuisine. Perfect for a quick snack or side dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine Venezuelan flour, Aerated, Yeast, And, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add Lemony to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal portions, shape each into a ball, and flatten slightly into disks.
Cook the flatbreads for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and puffed.
